An exceptional combination of space, character, and flexibility awaits in this approximately 2,500-square-foot colonial in Canton, within the highly sought-after Plain Local School District! Offering five bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and one half bath, this home provides a rare opportunity to enjoy a substantial layout along with amenities that set it apart. The living room makes an immediate impression with exposed wood ceiling beams and a wood-burning fireplace, adding warmth and timeless charm to the heart of the home. Five bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, a distinctive private-entry suite, a wood-burning fireplace, and an in-ground pool: opportunities to find this much versatility under one roof don't come around every day. Schedule your private showing and explore everything this Canton colonial has to offer! This one won't last long!

After 42 years of memories by one family, this solid home is ready for it's next chapter. 1920s character inside, the costly mechanical work already done, and a clear project outside baked into the asking price to build your equity. This 1922 two-story in Plain Local Schools has 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath and 1,414 sq ft. The house is ready for you to make it yours. Hardwood floors run through the living room, dining room and two of the bedrooms, and the original wood trim and doors are still in place. The living room centers on a wood-burning brick fireplace and opens through an arched doorway to the dining room and its wall of windows. The kitchen has a full wall of cabinets, the appliances stay, and a door leads out to the enclosed rear porch. Upstairs, the largest bedroom has windows on two walls. Enclosed front and rear porches give you three-season space for a morning coffee or a reading chair. The furnace was replaced in '20, the water heater was replaced in '18, the electrical has been updated, and there's central air. The exterior is where your sweat equity goes: the roof, gutters, siding and windows need updated, but eight of the custom-sized replacement windows are already bought and stay with the house, including the big dining room one. Out back are a fenced side patio, a deep yard with mature trees and a detached 1-car garage. The full basement has laundry, a utility sink and room for storage. Sold as-is. A renovation loan can roll the exterior work into one mortgage. Bring your ideas and your toolbox, and give this 1922 house its next hundred years. Seller is not accepting assignable agreements (wholesaling) at this time.
